pin_mux_from_DS_Table_4_3.note: Function0=input, Function1=output, Function9-13 reserved; F14 = EINT (DS 4.3 p.28)
pin_mux_from_DS_Table_4_3.PB_bank_reset: all PB2-PB7 reset Z, PU/PD, 4 mA, VCC-IO
pin_mux_from_DS_Table_4_3.PB0_PB1: not bonded in eLQFP128 (absent from Table 4-2)
pin_mux_from_DS_Table_4_3.UART0_options: PF2(F3)=UART0-TX / PF4(F3)=UART0-RX (shared with SDC0 CLK/D3), or PE2(F6)=UART0-TX / PE3(F6)=UART0-RX

boot.boot_media_supported: SD card, eMMC, SPI NOR, SPI NAND (DS 2.2.1 p.4; D1-H UM 3.3.2.1)
boot.boot_select_pins: BOOT-SEL0 = PC4 (pin 17), BOOT-SEL1 = PC5 (pin 16) (DS Table 4-3); these are the SPI0 MOSI/MISO pins. Both reset with internal pull-up (Table 4-2: PC4, PC5 reset state PU).

GPIO_boot_select_table_D1-H_UM_Table_3-5.source: D1-H User Manual v1.0, 3.3.2.1, p.147 (printed)/PDF p.160
GPIO_boot_select_table_D1-H_UM_Table_3-5.status_register: SYS_CFG VER_REG 0x03000024 bit[12:11] BOOT_SEL_PAD_STA; bit[8] FEL_SEL_PAD_STA (0: Run_FEL, 1: Try Media Boot) (UM 3.4.3.2 p.155)

boot.applicability_to_F133: D1-H UM is for D1-H (same BROM family, soc id 0x1859 per sunxi-tools/xfel). No F133-specific BROM chapter found in F133 datasheet v1.0 or rev 2.3. MangoPi MQ (D1s/F133) schematic silkscreen note: 'SEL[1:0] 00: NOR > NAND, 01: SD > NOR > Other, (check)10: SD > NAND > Other, 11 SD0 > EMMC2 > EMMC2_USR > Other' - consistent with UM.
boot.BOOT_MODE: BOOT_MODE eFuse bit: 0 = GPIO select, 1 = eFuse select (UM Table 3-4). eFuse Try mode order: SMHC0 -> SPI NOR -> SPI NAND -> SMHC2 (UM 3.3.2.1).
boot.order_after_00_then_FEL: UM Table 3-5 states 00 = 'SPI NOR->SPI NAND' only. What BROM does when all media fail (fall back to USB FEL) is drawn in Figure 3-5 'BROM Process' but the figure's text labels are not extractable (blank in PDF render) -> NOT_FOUND in text. Common community knowledge that BROM falls back to FEL is NOT verified from a manufacturer document here.
boot.FEL_entry_condition: UM 3.3.2.2: 'If the FEL pin is detected to pull low, the system will jump to the mandatory upgrade process' -> FEL process (USB: Clock_init, USB_init, wait for USB connection, USB enums - Figure 3-8). FEL pin status = SYS_CFG 0x03000024 bit[8]. Which physical package pin is the 'FEL pin' on F133 eLQFP128: NOT_FOUND (no FEL pin in F133 Table 4-2). MangoPi MQ implements a 'FEL' button S1 that shorts SPI0_MOSI (PC4/BOOT-SEL0) to GND (schematic p.2) - inference: forcing boot failure/selection via BOOT-SEL0, not documented by Allwinner.

SPI_NOR_boot0_format.eGON_header: NOT_FOUND in Allwinner docs (sunxi-tools bootinfo.c defines BOOT0_MAGIC 'eGON.BT0' generically - community source, not F133-specific)

xfel.supports: D1, D1s, F133 (support-list.md: ID 0x00185900, Basic/Reset/Sid/Jtag/DDR/SPI NOR/SPI NAND all supported); chips/d1_f133.c name 'D1/F133', detect id 0x00185900 + BROM word 0x43014281
xfel.spi_payload_pins: payloads/d1_f133/spi/source/sys-spi.c configures PC2,PC3,PC4,PC5 to function 2 (SPI0 CLK/CS0/MOSI/MISO) only; PC6 (WP) and PC7 (HOLD) are NOT configured -> board must pull WP#/HOLD# high externally (MangoPi MQ: 10K pull-ups). SPI0 clock: PLL_PERI0 source, /1, /6, then SPI CCR 0x1000.
xfel.spinor_addressing: spinor.c supports 3- and 4-byte address_length, read opcode 0x03

sunxi-fel.supports: soc_info.c: soc_id 0x1859 'Allwinner D1/D1s/R528/T113-S3' (name R528) -> basic FEL supported
sunxi-fel.spiflash: fel-spiflash.c spi0_init() has no case for 0x1859 -> prints 'SPI support not implemented yet' -> spiflash-info/read/write NOT supported for D1/F133 at this commit
